ガソリンスタンド

A roadside stop for loot and abandoned cars.

遊び方

Use the recycler for recyclable items. Raw resources cannot go in, and a full output stops the machine.

主な報酬

Wooden crates can yield Scrap and varied supplies; a repairable car may be nearby.

危険

The recycler is audible, and any player can drive an unclaimed car.

Recycler

There is a recycler here. It breaks down recyclable items and makes noise while running.
